Where is the best seafood on Koh Samui? | Bang Por on the north-west coast for waterfront seafood houses at sunset, Maenam for the MICHELIN-listed Jun Hom and Ko Seng, Bang Rak's beach strip near Big Buddha, Baan Suan Lung Khai in Taling Ngam (Bib Gourmand 2026, reservation only) and the Lamai Seafood Market for a cheap evening.
How is seafood priced in Thailand? | Usually by weight from a display on ice, either per kilo or per 100 g, so a board saying 100 may mean 1,000 THB a kilo. Ask how it is priced, watch it weighed, agree the total and the cooking style, and check the bill for extras before you pay.
Where do locals eat seafood on the north coast? | In Bang Por, west of Maenam, which has waterfront seafood restaurants on the sand where locals eat, with sunsets over the sea. Bang Por Seafood Takho, MICHELIN Selected in 2026, opens about 10:00–22:00, with meals at about 300–500 THB per person; book or arrive early for a sunset table at weekends.
Can I buy fish at Hua Thanon market? | Yes. The fish market in Hua Thanon, south of Lamai, opens about 07:00–18:00, but the best of the catch is gone by mid-morning, so go early. Prices for raw fish are negotiable. Some nearby food stalls may cook what you buy for a fee, but it isn't a set service, so ask first.
What is wai khua? | Samui's signature dish: octopus simmered in coconut milk with southern spices. Look for it at southern Thai restaurants in Maenam, Bang Por and Taling Ngam, and try crab curry with betel leaves while you're there.
Is seafood safe to eat on Samui? | Generally yes at busy restaurants and markets with plenty of ice and quick turnover. Choose fish with clear eyes, be more careful with mussels, clams and oysters in the hot months, drink sealed water and carry an allergy card in Thai if you react to shellfish or fish sauce.
How do I get a table at Samui's Bib Gourmand seafood restaurant? | Book ahead by phone: Baan Suan Lung Khai, Samui's 2026 MICHELIN Bib Gourmand in Taling Ngam, takes reservations only and opens daily 11:00–14:00 and 16:30–19:00. Call ahead, especially in high season, and allow 30–40 minutes' drive from Chaweng.
How do I ask for less spicy seafood in Thai? | Say "mai phet" for not spicy or "phet nit noi" for a little spicy. Southern Thai cooking is hotter than most visitors expect, so even "a little spicy" can be fiery; for children, ask for mai phet and order a steamed or grilled dish with the sauce on the side.
